subject: Q2 OKR framing, owners, and QBR readiness
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Klein <sarah.k@orioncloud.com>, engops@verdant-ai.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 OKR framing, owners, and QBR readiness

Team —

Quick kickoff note as we lock in Q2 objectives and the QBR packet. I took a pass at the framing and attached a draft spreadsheet (Q2_OKR_draft.xlsx) and a starter QBR deck (QBR_prep_deck.pptx). High level asks below: 

1) Owners: please confirm the owner for each objective/key result in the spreadsheet by EOD Wednesday (3/31). If you think an objective needs a different owner, propose the swap and rationale.

2) Metrics: check the baseline values and target cadence in the sheet. If the metric is noisy (e.g., latency p95), add a measurement note in the comments column.

3) Dependencies: call out any cross-org blockers. I added a column for infra/ops dependencies; if you need an escalation, ping Vivek and I.

4) QBR packet: the attached deck is intentionally light. If you have a slide request (metrics, demo, risk), drop a short bullet into the shared Drive link below and I’ll stitch.

Proposed timeline: owner confirmations by 3/31, final OKR file by 4/1 morning, leadership sign-off on 4/1 afternoon, QBR dry-run 4/2. If anything here is unrealistic, say so.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ2_OKR_folder
Jira for infra dep: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-2345

Attachments: Q2_OKR_draft.xlsx, QBR_prep_deck.pptx

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR framing, owners, and QBR readiness

Logan — thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes inline: 

- Objective 2 (Reduce inference unit cost): agree with owner (Aditya) but suggest replacing "cost per 1k tokens" with "cost per 1k effective tokens" to account for caching/batching. I left a comment in the spreadsheet cell.
- For p95 latency target under Objective 1, proposal: move from 150ms to 140ms given recent infra optimizations. I marked this in the sheet.
- I opened a Jira ticket for the shared KV cache dependency (INF-2345). If EngOps can commit to the rollout by 4/10 that's adequate for the stretch targets.

I also recommend we add a single slide showing the fallback policy (model variants + region routing) to the QBR deck. That helps the execs understand resilience choices.

No objections to the timeline. I can host the leadership sign-off on 4/1 at 3pm PT if that works for everyone.

-Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR framing, owners, and QBR readiness

Thanks Logan — good start. Two items from GTM/resource side: 

1) The owner listed for Objective 4 (Expansion: 3 enterprise pilots) is currently overloaded. I attached a quick resourcing heatmap (resourcing_heatmap.csv). We should move primary ownership to Grace for the pilot orchestration and keep Aditya as technical lead. Grace, can you confirm?
2) For the QBR slides, Marketing would like a customer highlight from Verdant AI. Sarah K. (copied) can we ask Verdant for a short quote + logo by 4/1? That would strengthen the expansion narrative.

If we reassign ownership as suggested we should still hit the timeline but need a 30-min sync to confirm roles — propose 3/30 10:30am PT.

Laura Bennett
VP, Growth & GTM
Redwood Inference
